Nirvana is not a real place that can be "founded." Nirvana is a concept in Buddhism, representing the ultimate goal of spiritual liberation and the end of suffering. It is not a physical location that can be established or founded by a group or individual. 

In Buddhism, Nirvana is often described as a state of mind where all suffering and desire have been extinguished, and one achieves enlightenment. It is not something that can be "founded" in the way that a country or organization can be founded.
